card.name: Inside febrile neutropenia and similar terms
card.fires_on: The ending "ile" of "febrile" right before "neutropenia" in adverse-event text. It also fires on a few other partly written medical terms such as pneum|on|itis and Squ|amous.

modes.label: Febrile neutropenia
modes.description: The "ile" ending of "febrile" before "neutropenia" in trial toxicity reports and dose-adjustment rules.

modes.label: Other split medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of other long medical words, such as pneumonitis or squamous, and the word fertility.

card.plain: It fires on the end of the word febrile when it is followed by neutropenia in side-effect and dosing text.
